Elena (docs): quick sync - drafting a short migration note for removing /v1/invoke. goal: one-paragraph notice, two tiny snippets (JS + curl), and a checklist. target public notice: Oct 1.

Rafi (sdk): I'll paste a compact JS snippet that maps old -> new fields and recommends pinning model@date for deterministic output. will keep it 6 lines.

Noor (prod): Add a brief fallback section: if a model@version is missing we route to the alias and emit fallback.metric. include canary header example: X-Canary:1 and note about embedding-dim changes.

Elena (docs): include a checklist: 1) tokenization counts, 2) embedding dims, 3) smoke test (50 prompts), 4) API scopes. add enterprise contact line for Dedicated.

Rafi (sdk): snippet (draft):
```js
// v1 -> v2 quick map
const v1 = { model: "rwd-mini", input: "hello" }
const v2 = { model: `${v1.model}@2024-10-01`, input: v1.input, meta: v1.meta||{} }
client.responses.create(v2, { headers: { 'X-Migrate-From': 'v1' } })
```

Rafi (sdk): curl example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Migrate-From: v1" -d '{"model":"rwd-mini@2024-10-01","input":"hello"}'`

Ian (legal): wording looks fine; add sentence: "No stored customer data will be deleted or moved as part of this API change." Enterprise customers on Dedicated: coordinate timelines with account teams.

notifier-bot: Draft PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6233 (contains snippets, checklist, FAQ).

Elena (docs): action items: Rafi -> final snippets into PR (today), Ian -> legal copy check (48h), Noor -> runbook & banner (by Sep 15), Elena -> publish notice (Sep 22). I'll post a short Slack announcement once PR merges. :white_check_mark:
